explication: Open Claude Cowork is an Electron desktop chat app backed by an Express service. A user selects a provider and sends a message; the renderer uses the preload bridge to call the backend, which supplies Composio MCP tools and dispatches the request to Claude or Opencode. Provider output streams back for rendering, including text and tool activity. Chat sessions are retained in provider memory, and Claude can load project skills. README also describes Secure Clawdbot, but its implementation is absent from this repository tree; UI details are based on partial renderer excerpts.
